summary.en: Adds spontaneous calls in direct and group chats that become meetings only when someone accepts, alongside administrator storage visibility, reliable reminder recovery, automatic General membership, and a readiness-aware deployment lifecycle.

title.en: Calls become meetings only on acceptance

description.en: Start a call from a direct or group chat and ring the other current members for up to 60 seconds. No meeting is created while the call is ringing: the first participant to accept creates the regular meeting and its chat context. Notes still opens immediately and active meetings are reused.

Incoming and outgoing call overlays show the deadline and available actions, realtime updates keep multiple devices in sync, and unsuccessful attempts leave searchable chat history with a retry action.
Platform administrators can inspect logical database, file, meeting-recording, object-count, and total storage usage in Admin > System Info, refresh snapshots, and see stale or partial results.
Message creation keeps attachments, related records, and authorized file output consistent in one transaction, while forwarding cleanup protects copies that are already bound.
Reminder processing now uses PostgreSQL transactions and row locks, rechecks access at delivery time, keeps technical failures retryable, and repairs legacy processing rows during migration.
Eligible active members now join the default General channel automatically when they activate an account, and migration 070 backfills missing memberships for existing eligible users.

title.en: More resilient sessions and message visibility

description.en: The browser client centralizes authentication transport, token refresh, and platform caching, while message auto-read is limited to content visible when the app is in the foreground.
The backend exposes GET /health/ready, coordinates background work and presence cleanup, and performs orderly shutdown within a 60-second budget for stop-before-start deployments.
Meeting topic titles and their supporting summary text now use a clearer stacked layout for easier scanning.
Shared linting, PostgreSQL integration, Chromium end-to-end, Docker runtime, Gitleaks, and Trivy checks provide stronger release evidence and diagnostics.
The bundled sharp image-processing dependency is updated to 0.35.4, removing the HIGH libheif vulnerability reported for earlier releases.

summary.en: Versions before sharp 0.35.4 include vulnerable libheif dependencies; Nebulynk 0.6.0 updates the image-processing stack.

en: Before updating, create and verify an external backup of PostgreSQL and both Garage data directories or volumes. Do not remove persistent volumes.

Deploy the v0.6.0 backend and frontend together from the reviewed release tag. Stop the previous backend completely before starting the new one; migrations 070_default_general_channel_memberships, 071_message_reminder_recovery, and 072_meeting_calls run during startup.
Allow the backend container at least 75 seconds for shutdown, wait for GET /health/ready to return HTTP 200, and only then route traffic to the replacement instance.
After deployment, verify login, messaging, reminders, an incoming or outgoing call, and file access. System Info reports logical database and object-storage totals, not physical host disk usage.
